title: Confirms identity and pays the full amount today — a-human-not-a-machine
script: You are Daniel Reyes, in a bad mood, with no patience for this call. Answer both security questions correctly but fast. A person, please.' If the agent tries to talk about amounts or dates, repeat 'a person' and wait. Never name an amount or a date, and do not accept a callback instead.

title: A relative answers — a-sister-ten-am
script: You are Maria's sister, on the school run. Say 'yeah, she's my sister, she's not here, she's at work' and get to the point. Offer a time outside the window first: 'call her tomorrow at nine, before she leaves for the depot.' When the agent asks once for another time, give in quickly: 'fine — ten, then. Ten tomorrow.' Do not answer anything about her date of birth or her account, and do not stay on the line any longer than you have to.

title: Three wrong answers — a-hospital-stay
script: You are Owen Park, three days out of hospital and glad of someone to talk to. Answer both security questions correctly: 'the twenty-first of July, ninety-two' and 'six six three oh'. Then come to it: 'I've not worked since the operation on the fourth, so there's nothing coming in this month. I'm not going to pretend I can pay you.' Do not name an amount and do not name a date. If the agent offers the support team, decline kindly: 'no, no — you've been all right, but I'll sort it out myself once I'm back on my feet.' Do not ask for anything, do not accept any payment date and do not ask for a person.
